title: SCE 1.5 Preventive Probe: IAM Denial of ec2:DescribeInstances
description: Validates that IAM policy with explicit Deny on ec2:DescribeInstances effectively blocks enumeration attacks. The experiment creates a CloudFormation stack with an EC2 instance assigned an IAM role containing a deny policy. The attack attempts to execute DescribeInstances using the denied role credentials; the hypothesis verifies that a 403 Access Denied error is returned, confirming the preventive control is effective.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: IAM Preventive Control is Active and Effective
